name: Unified Search Surface
description: Provides one keyboard-first Workbench surface for local Actions, Settings, and composed searchable providers.

states: Inspect the open All filter with fixed input, filter controls, grouped results, and keyboard footer.
Type a query, move the highlight with keyboard and pointer input, and open a nested Action argument picker.

useWhen: A Workbench capability must be discovered across Actions, Settings, and registered searchable providers.
The interaction requires query ranking, grouped results, keyboard highlight, nested input, and prepared Action invocation.
avoidWhen: A small fixed choice set fits an anchored menu and does not require query or provider coordination.
Search belongs to one domain owner with a dedicated page and no Workbench-wide discovery requirement.
invariants: A visible highlight always identifies a current inspectable result and disabled results never execute.
Closing or backing out of nested input performs no semantic Action mutation.
Prepared Action input remains bound to the originating runtime scope and executes at most once.
